verdict.rationale: Decagon has a dedicated Testing & QA product page describing Duet-generated tests covering diverse pathways to verify agent accuracy, policy adherence, and brand voice, plus Experiments for controlled production rollouts and Duet's ability to generate AOPs from past customer interactions — directly supporting pre-launch simulation/testing against historical patterns. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the testing workflow (e.g., a case study showing historical-ticket replay results) and detail on how 'historical tickets' specifically are ingested into test suites.
